a:r.a:t: From a gene list to six prioritized stock tables
Curated / GWAS / transcriptomics list of fly genes (FBgn)
Pull all stocks + alleles, constructs, phenotypes, references
Collection, reagent type, phenotype and sleep-term relevance
Each stock lands in the first bucket it qualifies for
The six priority buckets (applied top-to-bottom; a stock appears in only one)
Phenotype gate: every table keeps only stocks with an associated phenotype. Sleep / circadian / rhythm / locomotor terms flag literature-supported reagents.
